title: Zero-Shot Conversational Stance Detection: Dataset and Approaches
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the technical performance of NLP models in a conversational stance detection task. While the dataset includes targets involving social and moral issues (e.g., LGBTQ rights, surrogacy, family planning), the primary objective is evaluating models on their ability to classify linguistic stances (Favor, Against, or Neutral) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical systems themselves.
